title: Leakage-safe history affinity + LambdaRank
hypothesis: Past user-category, author and duration affinity combined with a user-grouped ranking loss will improve top-of-list ordering.

title: BPR with exposed negatives
hypothesis: Pairwise optimization over positives and actually exposed negatives will align collaborative learning with within-user ranking.

title: Causal DIN-style sequence model
hypothesis: Candidate-aware attention over only pre-impression interactions will capture short-term interest absent from aggregate features.

title: MMoE auxiliary-feedback training
hypothesis: Shared experts trained on click, like, follow and long-view outcomes will regularize sparse preference representations.

title: Censored watch-time auxiliary objective
hypothesis: A one-sided loss for completion-censored watch time will provide denser supervision for long-view ranking.

title: Temporal drift-aware reweighting
hypothesis: Recency weighting and time features will reduce the train-to-validation distribution shift without changing model capacity.

title: Within-user rank blend of complementary champions
hypothesis: Blending rank-normalized predictions from structurally different strong models will reduce uncorrelated ranking errors.

title: Random-exposure bias audit
hypothesis: An unbiased random-exposure diagnostic will reveal whether validation gains depend on logging-policy bias.
